scheme.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
scheme.implementing_agency: State/UT Governments, District Administration, Gram Panchayats/ULBs
scheme.description: IGNWPS is a component of NSAP providing monthly pension to BPL widows. Central Government contribution: Rs 300/month for age 40-79 years, Rs 500/month for age 80 years and above. Pension disbursed through DBT to Aadhaar-linked bank or post office account.
scheme.voice_summary: The widow pension is for widows aged 40 to 79 from below poverty line families. The central share is 300 rupees a month.
eligibility: Widow must be aged 40 years or above
Widow must be aged 79 years or below (Rs 500/month for 80+)
Applicant must belong to a BPL household
documents: Widow Certificate / Death Certificate of Spouse
application_process: offline: Obtain application form from Gram Panchayat / BDO office.
offline: Attach death certificate of husband, age proof, BPL card, and bank passbook.
offline: Submit to Social Welfare Officer / BDO office.
online: Visit the official NSAP portal (nsap.nic.in) or state social welfare department portal.
online: Select 'Apply Online' and choose 'Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)'.
online: Upload death certificate of husband, age proof (40+), and BPL proof.
online: Provide bank account details for DBT pension transfer.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Aadhaar number or enrollment slip for identity verification

documents.name: Proof of Age (40+ years)
documents.description: Birth certificate, school certificate, EPIC, or medical officer age certificate

documents.name: Widow Certificate / Death Certificate of Spouse
documents.description: Certificate confirming widow status issued by competent authority, or death certificate of spouse

documents.name: BPL Card / Certificate
documents.description: BPL ration card or certificate issued by designated authority

documents.name: Bank / Post Office Passbook
documents.description: Active bank or post office savings account passbook with IFSC/branch code

procedure_steps.text: Obtain application form from Gram Panchayat / BDO office.
Attach death certificate of husband, age proof, BPL card, and bank passbook.
Submit to Social Welfare Officer / BDO office.
Visit the official NSAP portal (nsap.nic.in) or state social welfare department portal.
Select 'Apply Online' and choose 'Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)'.
Upload death certificate of husband, age proof (40+), and BPL proof.
Provide bank account details for DBT pension transfer.

rules.logic: {"op": "AND", "items": [{"desc": "Widow must be aged 40 years or above", "source": "Page 65, NSAP IGNWPS Eligibility", "field": "age", "op": ">=", "value": 40}, {"desc": "Widow must be aged 79 years or below (Rs 500/month for 80+)", "source": "Page 65, NSAP IGNWPS Eligibility", "field": "age", "op": "<=", "value": 79}, {"desc": "Applicant must be a widow", "source": "Page 65, NSAP IGNWPS Eligibility", "field": "marital_status", "op": "==", "value": "WIDOW"}, {"desc": "Applicant must belong to a BPL household", "source": "Page 65, NSAP IGNWPS Eligibility", "field": "is_bpl", "op": "==", "value": true}]}

procedure_meta.fees: Free of cost / No application fee

catalog_descriptions.en: The widow pension is for widows aged 40 to 79 from below poverty line families. The central share is 300 rupees a month.
catalog_descriptions.hi: विधवा पेंशन गरीबी रेखा से नीचे के परिवारों की 40 से 79 वर्ष की विधवाओं के लिए है। केंद्रीय हिस्सा 300 रुपये प्रति माह है।
catalog_descriptions.ta: விதவை ஓய்வூதியம் வறுமைக் கோட்டிற்குக் கீழே உள்ள குடும்பங்களைச் சேர்ந்த 40 முதல் 79 வயது வரையிலான விதவைகளுக்கு வழங்கப்படுகிறது. மத்திய அரசின் பங்கு மாதத்திற்கு 300 ரூபாய் ஆகும்.
